subject: headphones
title: What If Your Headphones Were Always at Full Volume?

scenes.text: What if your headphones were always at full volume? The damage would be silent, and it would stay.
The World Health Organization's limit: 85 decibels is safe for about eight hours a day.
At 100 decibels, as loud as a dance club, the safe dose runs out in just 15 minutes.
European experts found that listening loud for over an hour a day puts up to one in ten people at risk of permanent loss within five years.
The WHO estimates about 1.1 billion young people already listen in ways that risk their hearing.
And as the WHO's chief put it: once you lose your hearing, it won't come back.
